notes: BEST IN-COUNTY HALL FIND. Legion Auxiliary runs a weekly Friday Night Supper, $14, from 4PM, takeouts available, open to the community. BUT THE MENU ROTATES - fish weeks confirmed Nov 2023, Jan 2025 and every Friday through March 2025; Oct 2025 was a cheeseburger sub. So it is a year-round Friday supper on which fish appears many weeks, not a guaranteed weekly fry. ADDRESS BLANK ON PURPOSE: the 311 Walnut St in directories is the Marathon City Municipal Center, not the hall. Curator must call for the street address and which Fridays are fish.

HIGHEST-VALUE UNCONTACTED LEAD IN WAUSAU. Verified open on Google Maps (4.1, 15 reviews) with reviews citing 'Nice bar and good food' and hall rental - so it has a real bar, kitchen and hall. Weekly public Wednesday bingo. No fish fry mentioned anywhere. A post with a bar and kitchen in the middle of Wausau is exactly the profile that runs an unadvertised Friday fry. Alternate phone 715-355-8788.

Address and phone corroborated on Google Maps (4.9, 11 reviews). Real clubhouse with bar canteen and hall rentals. Runs recurring PUBLIC meals - Facebook advertises steak feeds 4:30-8PM and reviews praise steak feeds and pancake breakfasts. No fish fry documented, but strongest in-county profile of a hall that could be running one unadvertised.

Locally the Peplin VFW. SPLIT IDENTITY: Google Maps and the post name say Mosinee (54455) but the post's own site gives the municipality as Kronenwetter - geocode carefully. Office hours Tuesdays 1-6PM only; hall rented for events. A Google review praises the food at their fall muster. No Friday fry or regular public meal found.

venue_name: Otto H. Kops American Legion Post 358
notes: The only western-towns Legion post that owns its own hall, rented for showers, weddings, meetings. But no fish fry anywhere on its page or calendar - its recurring public meal is six pancake breakfasts a year, Oct-Mar. One call is worth it, but evidence points to no.

STRONGEST CONFIRMED HALL FRY ANYWHERE IN THE SWEEP and the only weekly year-round one. Baked or deep-fried cod, shrimp, chicken strips, steak, burgers; fries or potato salad, rye bread, salad bar. Facebook posts in Feb AND Sept confirm not Lent-only. Public dining per the city directory and Clark County Tourism; Tavern League member. Verified active on Google Maps (4.7, 96 reviews). CAVEAT: Neillsville is ~50 minutes southwest of Wausau, well outside the current footprint.

MONTHLY, NOT WEEKLY - the post's own page is titled 'Monthly Fish Fry', calendar shows single Fridays. Currently 'Closed for the summer, Fish Fry will resume this fall' so roughly fall through spring. Deep fried or baked fish and/or shrimp, baked potato or fries, salad bar. The Loyal chamber's 'Every Friday Night' claim conflicts with the post's own site and appears stale. Far outside the footprint.
MONTHLY, not weekly. City of Greenwood lists the post as a dining establishment. Facebook advertises 'our monthly fish fry' on single Fridays 4-7PM. Species never named. Far outside the footprint.
